verdict.rationale: LobeHub's developer docs list an official CLI for operating an existing instance from a terminal, with a CLI README and task examples under 'Using the CLI'. A separate official marketplace CLI (@lobehub/market-cli / lhm) installs skills via npx and logs in to publish and version MCP listings. Missing for 10: in-depth command reference beyond snippet-level mentions, detail on which agent and chat workflows the instance CLI covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
